newsitem.title: USA: CME June hogs recoup losses on strong cash ideas.
newsitem.headline: CME June hogs recoup losses on strong cash ideas.

text.p: CME June hogs rallied strongly from early sharp losses and climbed back to little changed levels, boosted partly by talk that packers will have trouble buying enough hogs next week, floor sources said.
They said cash hogs should have a firm tone next week as a result of the supply tightness. LFG was a featured buyer with stops triggered as the rally gathered momentum.
June hogs rose to a peak of 82.400 cents a lb before slipping back slightly by 1255 CST to 82.175 cents, still well above the early low of 81.00 cents.
Press reports that Japan had denied it was considering cutting pork import tariffs to abate rising pork prices weighed heavily on CME hog futures early.
The denial came one day after reports that Japan was considering cutting the tariff early.
